title: Bowling Bulb
description: Painstakingly removes bowls from minecraft (with Farmer's Delight support)
body: Requires Farmer's Delight. Has optional integration with Nirvana, Brewin' and Chewin', and EMI.   This mod adds Bowling Bulb from Plants vs. Zombies 2. Except I accidentally added an Alternate Universe version of him which is an invisible eldritch reality bending entity that only interacts with the mortal plane by eating ALL OF YOUR BOWLS. Every time you eat an item with a bowl container the bowl is stolen by Bowling Bulb. You cannot prevent this. It is as if bowls were never even there. I did some testing and here's the specific things that having him in your world will do: - All bowl items had their crafting remainder set to air. This means that bowls should no longer pop up when you use a bowl item to craft something (looking at you Tomato Sauce) or be returned when you eat an item. - Shapeless crafting recipes that requires bowls no longer do. - Most [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) and [Dungeon's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons_delight) feasts had their recipes touched up so it still fills the crafting grid. Some cooking pot recipes that prominently feature their container in their properties have had their containers shoved into the main recipe. The specific recipes that have been changed are: from Dungeon's Delight, Au Rotten Potatoes, Chicken Jockey Sandwich, Malicious Sandwich, Ossobuco, and Snuffledogs; from [Brewin' and Chewin'](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewin-and-chewin), Fiery Fondue Pots; from Farmer's Delight, Gleaming Salad, Honey Glazed Ham, Roast Chicken, and Shepherd's Pie. ![Mushroom Stew crafted with 1 brown mushroom and 1 red mushroom with NO BOWLS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c612cd8e28e26684db36a1813a590dd675af4f65.png) - Farmer's Delight Cooking Pot will no longer have a container slot. Cooked meals will go directly to the output slot. - This also applies to Dungeons Delight's Monster Pot, and the respective slots have been removed from EMI and JEI plugins as well. - Since the meal-storing functionality of pots no longer work, both monster pots and cooking pots now stack to 64. - Suspicious Stew and Nirvana Healing Salves no longer require bowls. Also their EMI plugin has been changed to reflect this. I'm mentioning this because it was like three extra mixins since they use special crafting recipes. Thanks Bowling Bulb - If EMI is installed, the Suspicious Stew, (Nirvana) Healing Salves, and Suspicious Pipe recipes will use nice EMI versions that's condensed into 1 recipe instead of showing literally one recipe per flower for no reason. - You take portions from feasts by right clicking with an empty hand. - Bowls have been removed from every single loot table. If you add a loot table with bowls in it it'll get removed. The power of Bowling Bulb knows no bounds. - You can no longer milk mooshrooms; you can no longer feed brown mooshrooms flowers. Bowling Bulb is slowly becoming more powerful. Soon he might be able to eat Glass Bottles too. It will be a grim and disturbing day.
